full_prompt_en: A square, tightly cropped fashion-art photograph shows a woman's face in three-quarter side view, wrapped in lavish crimson fabric and covered with intricate floral face paint. Only one clear blue-green eye looks across the frame from beneath long dark lashes. Around that eye, saturated red pigment extends into a broad petal shape, with fine golden-yellow lines radiating down the cheek like the veins of a painted flower. Teal, cobalt, and small cream details curl along the bridge of the nose and toward the brow. The upper forehead is crowded by an ornate headdress of silver beads, sequins, tiny circular ornaments, and embroidered red-and-gold cloth. A large red fold frames the left edge, while more patterned textile bunches beneath the chin and across the lower foreground. Her pale skin and carefully shaped rose-red lips provide relatively smooth surfaces amid the intense decoration. The nose and lips are crisply lit and modeled; the painted area remains just as legible, so ornament and human features coexist rather than one hiding the other. Behind her, the shallow-focus background is a warm mosaic of blurred orange, red, teal, and gold vertical patches, echoing the costume without competing with the eye. The palette is led overwhelmingly by scarlet and crimson, sharpened by yellow rays and cool turquoise accents. Beadwork and thread glint in tiny highlights, and the fabric retains a woven, slightly metallic sheen. Light falls softly from the front right, illuminating the face and catching raised ornaments while deep red folds remain shadowed. The composition feels theatrical and intensely intimate, making an elaborate surface treatment readable through one steady eye and a very narrow field of view.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、裁切极紧的时尚艺术照片呈现女子四分之三侧脸，她被华丽绯红织物包裹，脸上覆盖精密花形彩绘。只有一只清楚的蓝绿眼睛从深色长睫毛下横望画面。眼周饱和红颜料伸成宽阔花瓣形，细金黄色线条像花脉般沿脸颊向下放射。青绿、钴蓝与小块奶油色细节沿鼻梁和眉部卷绕。上额被银珠、亮片、微小圆形饰物和红金刺绣布料构成的华丽头饰挤满。大块红布褶框住左缘，更多图案织物在下巴下和下方前景堆起。浅色皮肤与精心描出的玫瑰红嘴唇，在强烈装饰中提供相对平滑的表面。鼻子与嘴唇被清楚照亮和塑形；彩绘区域同样可读，因此纹饰与人的五官共存，没有谁遮掉谁。身后浅景深背景是模糊橙、红、青绿与金色竖向片块组成的暖色马赛克，呼应服饰而不与眼睛争夺焦点。配色由猩红与绯红压倒性主导，被黄色放射线与冷青绿点缀磨亮。珠饰和丝线闪出细小亮点，布料保有编织且略带金属的光泽。柔光从右前方落下，照亮面孔并抓住凸起饰物，深红褶层仍留在阴影里。构图戏剧化且极为亲密，让繁复表面处理透过一只坚定的眼睛和十分狭窄的视域变得可读。
style_prompt_en: A saturated fashion-art photographic treatment pushes a large smooth focal plane against densely patterned crimson and metallic textures in a very tight crop. Red dominates the frame in many values, from shadowed burgundy folds to vivid scarlet pigment, while small golden-yellow radial marks and turquoise-blue accents sharpen the contrast. Minute reflective points from beadlike and sequined surfaces sit beside matte paint and softly luminous skinlike areas, creating varied material response. Decorative curves, circular details, and bold petal-shaped patches crowd the upper and side regions; one cool-toned focal point remains sharply defined within them. The background dissolves into blurred vertical warm-and-cool fragments, keeping the front layers precise. Soft frontal-side lighting gives clean highlights to raised details and smooth convex planes, with deeper folds receding into rich red shadow rather than black. The composition is theatrical and compressed, using extreme proximity, tactile ornament, and a single concentrated point of clarity to organize visual abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 饱和的时尚艺术摄影处理在极紧裁切中，把一大片平滑焦点平面推向密集图案化的绯红和金属纹理。红色以许多明度主导画面，从暗酒红褶层到鲜猩红颜料，少量金黄放射笔痕与青绿蓝色点缀锐化对比。珠状与亮片表面的微小反光点挨着哑光颜料和柔亮的类肤表面，形成多样材质回应。装饰曲线、圆形细节和大胆花瓣形色块挤满上方与侧边，其中一处冷色焦点保持清晰。背景溶成模糊的暖冷竖向碎片，让前层保持精确。柔和的正侧光在凸起细节和平滑凸面上形成干净亮点，更深褶层退入浓郁红影而非黑色。构图戏剧化且压缩，以极近距离、有触感的纹饰和一个集中的清晰点组织视觉丰盛。
theme_en: A close side portrait with ornate floral face paint and crimson ceremonial fabric
theme_zh: 带华丽花形面绘与绯红礼仪织物的侧脸近景
name: Orlan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
